assumptions: 90000 MWh/month is total city baseline demand, with EV charging added separately.
NS1, NS6 and FUT are excluded; city_total demand scales to retained reference demand share.
One simulated January day, using a 30-day monthly normalization, base demand and no future growth.
100 synthetic EV sessions with 7.4 kW chargers, 14 kWh per car and 90% efficiency; location mix 70% residential, 20% workplace, 10% public.
Balanced equivalent synthetic MV network, not an as-built EDS model; 15-minute averages omit transients, harmonics and phase imbalance.
Stop at first electrical violation; stopped prefixes do not establish a full strategy comparison.
definition.hypothesis: 100 EVs can be served within electrical limits at 90000 MWh monthly city demand across four charging strategies.
definition.name: 100 EVs at 90000 MWh monthly city demand
